explored_pages_and_scenarios.page_title: Roost.ai | Your Testing Co-Pilot Powered by Generative AI and Large Language Models

potential_user_journeys.scenario_name: Configure and Save RoostGPT Test Suite
potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: A user configures a test suite by entering details and selecting appropriate options, then saves the configuration.

steps.element_description: Input the test suite name in the text field.
Choose 'Unit Test' as the test type from the options.
Set 'Java' as the code language from the dropdown.

expected_outcome: The test suite configuration is saved successfully.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User provides Github credentials and integrates the repository for version control.

steps.element_description: Enter the Github token in the password field.
Click the 'Verify' button to authenticate the integration.

expected_outcome: The Github repository is successfully integrated with the platform.
